bullets.text: CtrlS and Ciena are building high-capacity metro networks connecting nine data centres across five Indian cities including Chennai to boost infrastructure.
The office should monitor how this new high-speed data centre network initiative by CtrlS and Ciena impacts digital infrastructure growth in Chennai.

stories.title: CtrlS, Ciena to Build 100 Tb/s Data Centre Networks Across Five Indian Cities
stories.snippet: CtrlS Datacenters has partnered with US networking company Ciena to build five high-capacity metro networks connecting nine data centres across Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, New Delhi and Noida. The networks will provide…
